deviation: The draft lowers the availability commitment to 99.0%, below both the 99.9% playbook position and the 99.5% fallback. It also removes service credits, so Arcadia has no financial remedy for missed service levels.
suggested_text: The Supplier shall achieve at least 99.9% availability each month and shall meet the other service levels stated in this SOW. The Supplier shall credit 5% of monthly fees for each service level missed.
